targetYaml:
version: 1
kind: target
name: lab1
core:
    amf: ${LAB_AMF}
    plmn:
        mcc: "208"
        mnc: "93"
    slices:
        - sst: 1
          sd: "010203"
subscribers:
    - name: main
      first_supi: "208930100007500"
      count: 10
      ki: ${ORBIT_KI}
      opc: ${ORBIT_OPC}
ran:
    n2_source_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
        - 127.0.0.2
    n3_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
    gnb_ids:
        first: 7
        bits: 24
runYaml:
# An attach storm: the target's subscribers attached and released at a
# steady rate. Address-free: the core, keys and addresses come from the
# target (-t). Gated on attach success at least 0.99 (ADR-0008 resolved
# question 4); latency is reported, not gated, unless --gate adds it.
kind: run
workloads:
  - name: load
    attach: {count: 3, rate: 10, concurrency: 64}
until: {complete: true}
gates:
  - name: attach_success_ratio
    slo: {metric: attach.success_ratio, op: ">=", threshold: "0.99"}
  - name: registration_p99_ms
    workload: load
    slo: {metric: registration.p99_ms, op: "<=", threshold: "500ms"}
